subject: general
question: Which of the following awards was presented to Guru Bipin Singh, a popular Manipuri dancer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Guru Bipin Singh:-**

 
 
• Guru Bipin Singh was a renowned Manipuri dancer and choreographer who was instrumental in popularizing the dance form across the country.
 
• The award was given to him in the year 1984 for his contribution to the field of Manipuri dance.
 
• He was presented with the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, which is a national-level award given for performing arts in India. 
 
• He was also the founder of the Manipuri Nartanalaya, a dance academy in Imphal, which has produced many talented Manipuri dancers over the years.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Saraswati Samman:-**

 
 
• It is a prestigious literary award given in India, which recognizes outstanding contributions to literature in any of the 22 Indian languages. 
 
 
 
• **Kalamandal Puraskar:-**
 
 
• It is a cultural award given by the Kalamandalam Deemed University of Art and Culture in Kerala, which honors artists and scholars in the field of Indian classical arts.
 
 
 
• **Padma Shri:-**
 
 
• It is a civilian award given by the Government of India, which recognizes distinguished service in various fields such as arts, literature, science, social work, etc.
